text:
I had ankle pain and inflammation. I told the doctor, and he said he'd prescribe some anti-inflammatory medication.
He said, "I'll eat and take the medicine, then I'll let you know."

In the end, the doctor prescribed three different medications.
After taking them three times, my symptoms improved significantly.

On my first visit, the doctor should have been more polite. I requested a medical certificate for the next day, but they refused. They said I'd be fine with medication. But I have a fever; it won't go away in just one day with medicine. If my fever returns the next morning, do I have to drag myself back to the doctor? That's a waste of time.

I once went to see a doctor about cartilage inflammation.
The symptoms were like bending down to tie my shoelaces,
a stabbing pain in the chest.
I went to the doctor, they told me to bend down and straighten up, gave me medication, and it went away in two days. Thank you.

Saturday-Sunday, 8:00 AM-12:00 PM.
No symptom check, just dispense medication. Done. In less than 3 seconds.
